title: MV Trying to make a game about Shadow and Maria! (First time making things)

posts.author: DeterminedKid1000
posts.body:
Hi! I’m very new to these forums, so I’m really sorry if I’m messing up somehow, but I’m trying to make an RPG Maker game about Shadow and Maria’s life aboard the Space Colony ARK! Unfortunately I’m not very good at art though so it’s been a huge struggle. I did use a base reference to make this, but here is Maria! I even added her adorable sweater from Sonic 3!
I honestly really need help with this project, and I’m not expecting anyone to do so. But I hope if someone finds this post that they’ll like my Maria sprite. I worked really hard on this.

posts.author: DeterminedKid1000
posts.body:
I was really hoping someone would at least like this… I worked so hard.
I’m so stupid…
